Notes.Text:
This update for rpcbind fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-16461: stack buffer overflow in rpcinfo rpcbdump() short-mode version-list formatting (bsc#1272340).

Vulnerabilities.Description: A stack-based buffer overflow was found in rpcbind's rpcinfo utility. In rpcbdump() short mode (used by `rpcinfo -s`), version numbers from a remote RPCBPROC_DUMP reply are written into a fixed-size stack buffer without bounds checking. A user or administrator who runs `rpcinfo -s` against a malicious or compromised rpcbind endpoint could experience a crash or denial of service of the rpcinfo client.

ProductID: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server LTSS Extended Security 12 SP5:rpcbind-0.2.3-24.15.1
